headline: Executive order sets up a President's Council on Service and Civic Participation.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates a council tied to the President that deals with volunteer service and civic participation. No summary was provided, so the council's exact duties, members, and powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Volunteers and people active in community service
who_it_affects.how: The council's work appears aimed at people who volunteer or take part in civic life, though the specific effects are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 29, 2003; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
